thread:
alyssa: support escalation — ACME reporting a spike of 429s + p95 > 1s on /v1/generate in us-west-2 starting ~10:12 UTC. traces show `Retry-After: 60`. need eng-sre to triage.

ben: looking now. can you paste an example request id or trace?

support-oncall: pasted ticket trace: request_id=acme-req-20260312-9921. repro steps we ran: 1) POST /v1/generate prompt ~800 tokens, concurrency=8; 2) 429s started after ~30s, curl shows `Retry-After: 60`; 3) lowering concurrency to 1 removed 429s but caused queueing.

ben: grabbing limiter + config logs. initial log: 
```
2026-03-12T10:11:58Z limiter[us-west-2][srv-07] WARN request=acme-req-20260312-9921 limiter=global token_granted=false reason=quota_exceeded refill_rate=0.0166667 bucket_capacity=10 tokens_left=0
```
ben: intended refill_rate should be ~1.0 tokens/sec. 0.0166667 looks like 1 token/min. sounds like a units regression in the rollout.

maria: confirmed — config schema renamed `refill_per_min` -> `refill_per_sec` earlier; the deploy job migrated values incorrectly and left the per-minute numeric value in the new per-second field.

maria: config diff (artifact cfg-rl-20260312-9):
```
- limiters:
-   global:
-     refill_per_min: 60
+ limiters:
+   global:
+     refill_per_sec: 0.0166667
```

maria: rollout went to ~60% of us-west-2 hosts at 10:05 UTC.

ben: mitigation options: 
- runtime override to set `limiters.global.refill_per_sec=1.0` (fastest)
- rollback config rollout (safer but slower)
- increase bucket_capacity temporarily to absorb bursts

alyssa: do the runtime override and include audit/approver.

maria: applying override now via runtime-config API:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://runtime-config.internal/api/v1/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"path":"limiters.global.refill_per_sec","value":1.0, "note":"hotfix for units regression - oncall maria"}'
```

deploy-bot: config.override.applied user=maria env=prod region=us-west-2 path=limiters.global.refill_per_sec new_value=1.0 audit_id=ovr-1192

ben: seeing token refill climb and 429 rate drop. p95 latency trending down. monitoring backlog drains.

support-oncall: updated ACME; they report partial recovery ~10:14 UTC and continue to monitor.

alyssa: root cause: config rollout introduced a minutes->seconds unit mismatch for limiter refill values causing ~60x lower refill rate and quota exhaustion under bursty sustained traffic.

ben: post-incident mitigation proposals:
- add CI/schema validation to reject refill_per_sec values < 0.1 for global limiter
- add a canary traffic check: simulate sustained concurrency on canary hosts for 5m and assert limiter metrics
- alert: service-wide 429 rate > 1% sustained for 3m -> page eng-sre
- add a pre-merge test for config key renames and unit conversions
- dashboard: token-bucket fill % and effective refill_rate per region

maria: also propose a runtime automatic fallback: if effective refill_rate deviates >10x from expected in a region, auto-fail-open to previous config and page owners.

alyssa: plan approved. Ben, own alert/dashboard. Maria, own schema validation & pre-merge test. I'll run the postmortem and customer comms.

ben: created eng-sre ticket RI-9876 and linked logs/graphs: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RI-9876

maria: PR opened for schema validation: https://github.com/redwood/config/pull/425 — tests included, requesting reviews.

support-oncall: ACME confirms full recovery at 10:23 UTC and thanked ops team :thumbsup:.

alyssa: great response. filing action items in the ticket and closing incident for now :white_check_mark:
